messages:
chris: Hey team — customer just DM'd that a service-account JWT was committed to a public GitHub repo (they pasted the token). They want immediate revocation, a full access audit for the last 7 days, and guidance on rotating secrets stored in our KMS vs their on-prem HSM. Also seeing weird 401 spikes after they tried rotating on their side. Can SRE + Security triage?

maria: Copying. Can you drop the repo/link here and redact the token? We'll rotate and revoke as priority.

chris: https://github.com/example/repo/commit/abc123 (they redacted the token in the gist, but confirm it matched our service-account id sa-prod-42)

sam: On it — immediate plan: 1) create a new KMS key + alias and rewrap the credential; 2) create a limited-scope replacement token; 3) update secret in secret-store and trigger rolling deploy. Example commands:
```
aws kms create-key --description "sa-prod-42 rotation 2026-03-17"
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/sa-prod-42-20260317 --target-key-id <new-key-id>
# re-encrypt and put
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/secrets/sa-prod-42" --value "<rewrapped-secret>" --type SecureString --key-id <new-key-id>
```
I'll queue rotation-bot to coordinate.
messages_extra:
rotation-bot: Rotation job queued: job_id=rot-20260317-001 (owner=sam). Status: queued -> running.

anya: Security note: we need audit logs for the service account and the KMS key usage (last 7d). Enable verbose audit export for the tenant and export IAM/KMS logs to a locked S3 bucket for SOC/legal. Also check whether HSM wrap operations were used by this tenant. If any PII access shows up, flag GDPR/DP incident.

kev: 401 spike explanation: if clients cached long-lived JWTs signed by the old key, they'll fail once we rotate signing keys. Revoke old tokens server-side and force short-lived issuance. Revoke endpoint (internal):
POST https://internal-api.redwood.ai/v1/service-accounts/sa-prod-42/revoke
Body: { "token": "<token-or-all>" }

maria: Repro steps for support engineers: 1) try old token -> expect 401: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` 2) generate new token with limited scopes -> expect 200. Include these steps in the incident runbook.

chris: Customer is also asking what logs we retain and whether we can prove the exposed token did not access PII. legal help?

tara-legal: We can provide audit exports for the past 90 days. We'll need SOC to redact PII and produce a signed statement about access findings. Please file an evidence export request with tenant id and time window. Marking this high-sensitivity.

anya: Recommend communicating to customer: 1) rotate keys now, 2) adopt short-lived OIDC tokens for service accounts, 3) store wrapped secrets in their KMS/HSM and use our HSM-wrap integration to avoid plaintext in app config. Share this doc: https://redwood.example/docs/hsm-wrap and the quick snippet:
```
# hsm wrap example (customer side)
wrap_key = hsm.get_key("alias/customer/hsm-1")
wrapped = wrap_key.wrap(secret)
vault.store("/app/secrets/sa", wrapped)
```

kev: I'm running a repo-wide scan for other possible exposures (pattern: service_account, JWT, x-api-key) — command: `grep -R --line-number -E "service_account|JWT|x-api-key" /scans/latest/out || true` — will post hits.

maria: Created internal incident INC-2026-0347, SLA 2h for initial revocation + audit export. I'll coordinate with sam/anya/kev and ping customer with an ETA. (reacted :eyes:)

sam: Rotation started, deployment rolling update triggered. Will post final status when done. :thumbsup:

chris: Customer acked, they want a short bulletin for their security team once we have logs and rotation confirmation.

maria: Will prepare short bulletin template + redacted audit snapshot for legal review and then send to customer.

kev: Scan found 2 low-confidence hits (public fork) — triaging.

tara-legal: Preparing the export request. Please include key_ids, IPs, and truncated request paths for audit.

sam: Rotation job completed: job_id=rot-20260317-001 status=success. New alias=alias/redwood/sa-prod-42-20260317. Old key disabled.

maria: Closing loop: revoked old tokens, exported IAM/KMS logs to s3://inc-2026-0347-evidence, legal prepping redacted bundle for customer. TODO: follow-up doc with recommended customer-side controls (short-lived tokens + KMS-wrapped secrets).

chris: thanks all — customer satisfied for now.
notes: thread contains internal commands and links; tokens in messages are redacted by participants.
